enchantments.tooltip: Tendon Slice +6: On Hit: 6% chance to slow target's movement by 50% for 6 seconds.
Doublestrike 9%: Passive: 9% Enhancement bonus to Doublestrike. (Doublestrike is a chance to score an additional hit with a melee attack.)
Deception +6: +6 Enhancement bonus to hit and +9 to damage for any hit that would qualify as a sneak attack.
Insightful Combat Mastery +3: +3 Insight bonus to the DC to resist the character's Trip, Improved Trip, Sunder, Improved Sunder, Stunning Blow, and Stunning Fist attempts.
Mythic Belt Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
